Hon Precision.why: Makes final-test and SLT handlers; AI / HPC / ASIC chips were 77% of its H1 2026 order mix, with shipments for a TPU customer and US CPU / GPU / CSP customers
Hon Precision.evidence: Hon Precision 2026 Q2 investor presentation (MOPS 776920260730E001): AI / HPC / ASIC 77% of 2026 H1 order mix; TPU customer large-volume 26H2 SLT shipments to Taiwan / Singapore OSAT; US CSP customer next-gen CPU+TPU engineering handler shipping Sep-Dec 2026

players.product: Final-test and system-level-test (SLT) handlers with active thermal control for AI / HPC / ASIC chips (GPU, CPU, TPU); CPO / CPC test handlers

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue NT$24,518,966 thousand at a 56.15% gross margin, operating profit NT$12,046,256 thousand (49.1%), net income NT$10,100,517 thousand (40.7%), EPS NT$56.14 (full-year 2025: revenue NT$30,270,625 thousand, 56.54% gross margin, EPS NT$75.71).
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 revenue NT$24,518,966 thousand; gross margin 56.15%; EPS NT$56.14

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 H1 order mix: AI / HPC / ASIC (AI computing, server, networking, APU/GPU/CPU/FPGA) 77%, up from 72% in 2025; automotive 9% (from 11%); mobile AP / communication 8% (from 10%); consumer 5% (from 5%); memory / MEMS 1% (from 2%).
quarterly_data.figure: AI / HPC / ASIC 77% of 2026 H1 orders (72% in 2025)

quarterly_data.signal: Management outlook: 26H1 actual growth rate 45%+; order visibility extends to the end of 2026 and capacity planning to 27Q1. 2027 capacity expansion plan +50%: DeShen plant to begin production in 27Q1 (+15%), local production in China in 27Q1 (+20%), existing headquarters plant (+15%). Customer expansion: a U.S. auto customer's Thailand plant (26H2-27), OSAT new plants in the US / Singapore plus a China new plant (27Q1) and an OSAT new plant in Arizona (27Q2).
quarterly_data.figure: 2027 capacity +50% (DeShen +15%, China +20%, HQ +15%); order visibility to end-2026

quarterly_data.signal: CPO / CPC: INS4 OE SOW completed with shipments starting Oct 2026; the CPO lab (clean room) is completed and supports several customers' qualification; INS3 / INS4 are co-developed with major ATE vendors (multiple projects); a CPC project is co-developed with a major US networking customer and an ATE vendor.

Final test (FT): China auto / AI demand up 80% YoY; a US Austin customer's CPU shipments started in 26H2 with its GPU under qualification; a U.S. EV customer's tri-temp SLT is in mass production; a US GPU customer is in phase-1 qualification; a US CSP customer's next-gen CPU+TPU engineering handler ships Sep-Dec 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: China auto / AI FT demand +80% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: System-level test (SLT): a TPU customer's large-volume 26H2 shipments go to Taiwan / Singapore OSATs; China AI / HPC orders up 60% YoY; a U.S. auto customer's large-volume 26H2 shipments to its Thailand plant; a U.S. EV customer's highest-tier equipment ships in 26H2 to US, Taiwan and Korea OSATs; a US Austin customer's next-gen CPU shows strong 2027 demand; multi-site SLT (MSLT) expanding in China; large-package, automated handlers with advanced ATC (~10kW) start shipping Oct 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: China AI / HPC SLT orders +60% YoY; ~10kW ATC handlers ship from Oct 2026
